authoritative_feedback.requirement: Derive Freight Cost and Freight Selling Rate from the available dataset where the approved definition permits it.
Limit vessel options to Supramax and Handysize.
Keep Index and Alpha as controlled manual inputs for now.
Group variables by the calculation they support.
The system must be prescriptive, not merely descriptive.
Dataset Freight Rate is PILOG's freight selling rate.
Use 45000 MT physical cargo for port days and 46000 MT allocation quantity for freight revenue and voyage-cost allocation; superseded by mentor correction D-016.
Use owned PILOG vessel alternatives for this simulation; charter treatment is deferred.
Include all three commission rates; gross-revenue basis remains a simulation assumption.
Screen Supramax and Handysize and report the selected vessel class before commercial handoff.
